sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Discovery already supports hidden files (`DiscoverySettings.include_hidden` → `.hidden(!include_hidden)` on the walker). The gap is plumbing: the setting is built once from the global config at two call sites (roots.rs:178 scan/re-add; watch.rs:275 watcher rescan). This packet adds one persisted boolean per root (worktrees table), carries it from the CLI flag through the /roots body into RootReport and the store, and makes both call sites compute `include_hidden = config.scan.include_hidden || worktree.include_hidden`. The skip ledger gains a `hidden` reason so a default add explains itself. No change to the content-addressed skip, parser versions, embeddings or search.

value.rationale: One unit, one coder, no PM; o-prime coordinates directly (Jordan, 2026-09-02: dispatch the performance work to agents).

value.responsibility: per-root include_hidden: persisted, threaded into both discovery call sites, surfaced in status/tree and the skip ledger, proven on the test daemon with the pij extensions
value.interface: CLI `add --include-hidden|--no-include-hidden`; POST /roots body gains `include_hidden: Option<bool>`; RootReport + status/tree JSON gain `include_hidden: bool`; store `worktrees.include_hidden`; discovery ledger reason `hidden`. Additive envelope changes only.
value.test_strategy: store round-trip test; daemon fixture-root tests for scan/re-add/watch in both modes with a .git control; ledger + status/tree JSON assertions; one mutation receipt per rule; the test-daemon real-usage transcript
value.note: Tests ONLY on the dedicated test postmaster :5434 (FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://flowspace3:flowspace3@127.0.0.1:5434/flowspace3_test, container flowspace3-db-test). The real-usage receipt runs a SCRATCH daemon bound to :5434 and a free port — NEVER :7373 / :5433. Migration 0024 is new (never edit 0023).
Your worktree is fs3-hidden-dirs on branch 016-hidden-dirs. No prod. A scratch daemon for the receipt uses the :5434 database and a port you choose; kill it when done.

value.steps: None — single unit. o-prime squash-merges and bounces prod (daemon/store binary changes).
value.integration_proof: the real-usage criteria in the plan, measured on prod after the bounce

value.when: spawned by o-prime once the PR is up
value.inputs: re-add without the flag must not reset a stored true; both call sites (roots.rs:178 AND watch.rs:275) honour the per-root flag — a watcher rescan is the one people forget; the .git refusal survives include_hidden; the ledger `hidden` count is real (mutation), not decoration; the receipt counts are reproducible from the PR body on the test daemon

value.text: the watcher builds its settings once per worktree at startup — a flag flipped by re-add must reach the running watcher (re-read per rescan or restart the watcher for that root)
hidden directories bring large trees (.venv, .cache) — the deny list must still prune them under include_hidden; assert node_modules/.venv stay skipped
migration 0024 on prod runs at the next bounce; keep it a single nullable-free ALTER with a default so it is instant
